update_note: Governed contract change (spec/deployment/topology.md "Contract evolution"): DEP-004 materialized the durable operational-jobs family as an in-process module surface inside the web-api-boundary application (the DEP-003/RTN-012 precedent; no externalized process binding — recorded future work per component). The new component 'operational-jobs' (layer deployment, authority none — orchestration only) hosts the background operational jobs for reconciliation sweeps, clearing batch progression, netting-settlement progression and queue-draining support: durable job kinds on the DEP-003 substrate that derive work from the authorities' public read surfaces and emit protocol commands exclusively through the protocol gateway with deterministic idempotency keys (zero authority semantics, zero direct state mutation, never asserts settlement finality). The declared base records the DEP-004 dispatch base (main @ 2c3f9cf — the composed protocol runtime RTN-001..012 merged, which the jobs orchestrate over); the operational-jobs entrypoints arrive with the DEP-004 work item's tree and exist on disk there (the validator's honesty check). Owner stays "deployment" for every component; authority only in protocol-layer entries; the present-set gains exactly one component. All three surfaces — components.json, spec/deployment/topology.md and scripts/validate_deployment.py — were updated together in that one work item.

field_semantics.owner: Runtime/process owner. Always 'deployment': the deployment layer owns process topology, persistence infrastructure, queues, schedulers, workers, secrets, runtime configuration, CI/CD, observability, scaling, backups, recovery and environment isolation for every deployed component.
field_semantics.layer: Architecture layer whose authority the component hosts: 'protocol' (hosts protocol-owned authority), 'product' (hosts product-owned presentation semantics), 'deployment' (pure deployment infrastructure; hosts no protocol or product authority).
field_semantics.authority_hosted: The authority the component hosts. Components with layer 'protocol' list the protocol authorities they host; every other component's value must start with 'none' — financial authority exists only in protocol-layer components.
field_semantics.exists_in_repository_today: True only if the component's entrypoint paths exist in the repository at the declared base SHA. False means FUTURE-WORK: the component is deployment-owned capacity whose repository entrypoint arrives with the referenced future work.
field_semantics.repository_entrypoint: Object with 'status' ('present' or 'future-work'), 'paths' (repository-relative paths; non-empty and on disk when present; empty when future-work) and 'marker' (dependency-graph provenance; required when future-work).
field_semantics.route_surface: Optional: HTTP routes served by the component (documentation; not an existence-checked entrypoint).
field_semantics.environment_reachability: Canonical environment classes in which the component may run. Reachability is topology only: production reachability additionally requires the production_gate.
field_semantics.production_gate: Required whenever 'production' is reachable: the separately authorized production configuration that gates real financial effects. Sandbox/demo can never reach production financial effects without it (environments.md fail-closed rules F1-F8).
field_semantics.health_signal: Contract-level health signal the component must expose; bound to observability from DEP-002 onward.
field_semantics.rollback: Contract-level rollback mechanism; principles R1-R5 in spec/deployment/topology.md.
field_semantics.future_work: The future work that remains for a component whose in-process repository entrypoints exist today (rtn-plan-rulings.md Q3/delta 3): externalized process binding (DEP-002+), and for rail-touching components real-rail credential binding under DEP-005. Required and non-empty for every component; carries the FUTURE-WORK tag. The in-process form is the RTN wave's composed realization inside the web-api-boundary application — never a claim of externalized deployment, and no protocol semantic change.
field_semantics.updated_by: The work item that last performed a governed contract change on this registry (topology.md 'Contract evolution'). DEP-001 generated the contract; DEP-002 added the packaging delta checks; RTN-012 updated the present-set with the RTN wave's in-process entrypoints; DEP-004 added the operational-jobs family entrypoints.

components.name: Web/API boundary — PaySwap Next.js application
components.authority_hosted: none — hosts product-owned navigation, presentation and progressive disclosure (shell home '/', verification surface '/state-primitives') plus the server-side environment signal; hosts no financial authority, never writes authoritative state, never reaches external rails
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: the UI-011 product-port re-anchoring (rtn-plan-rulings.md Q5/delta 6) — the boundary's protocol operations forward through the protocol gateway once the product ports are re-anchored to the runtime (today the boundary hosts no protocol splice: the RTN wave's forbidden-surface rule keeps src/lib/protocol/ product-owned); target infrastructure binding from DEP-002 onward
components.production_gate: Production traffic is served only from the production environment with its separately authorized production configuration; PAYSWAP_ENV=production is set only there (environments.md fail-closed rules F2/F3).
components.health_signal: Liveness GET /api/health (200 while the process serves; no readiness logic, no secrets); readiness GET /api/ready — 200 with the startup-configuration checks summary when valid, 503 with the NAMED failing check ids (never values) when required configuration is missing (fail-closed F6; semantics in spec/deployment/packaging.md).
components.rollback: Stateless redeploy of the previous commit/build artifact; the shell holds no authoritative state, so rollback requires no data recovery.
components.startup_validation: src/lib/startup-config.ts (environment via src/lib/environment.ts; presence-only name checks)

components.name: Protocol gateway — authoritative protocol API
components.authority_hosted: the sole admission point for protocol commands — per-command validation against the owning authorities' registered schemas (the registry A01–A14 and A16 command authorities: Intent, Fulfillment Policy, Capability, Routing, Reservation, Liquidity, Credit, Queue, Clearing, Obligation, Netting, Settlement and Finality, Rail, Reconciliation, and Risk and Compliance Authorities), idempotent admission receipts, typed rejection evidence, and durable submission; hosts no authority of its own and implements no identity or market authority (rtn-plan-rulings.md Q4 — subject validation is per-command per owning authority)
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — the gateway as a separately deployed process with an HTTP readiness endpoint and observability binding (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (RTN-010, inside the web-api-boundary application) is the composed realization, not an externalized deployment
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration (DEP-002+ secret binding); sandbox/demo configuration can never reach production financial effects (environments.md F1-F8).
components.health_signal: Readiness endpoint; command acceptance rate and latency; durable-queue submit success (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; in-flight commands replay from the durable command queue; rollback never mutates authoritative state directly.

components.name: Transition runtime — single authoritative-state writer
components.authority_hosted: the single authoritative-state writer — the merged authorities' command surfaces (registry A01–A14 and A16) executed as hosted bindings through the dequeue → resolve-owning-authority → apply-transition → A15-evidence → atomic-commit path on the DEP-003 substrate; no other layer mutates authoritative state (the hard boundary)
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — the transition runtime as a separately deployed worker process fleet with observability binding (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (RTN-011, hosted on the DEP-003 substrate inside the web-api-boundary application) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; state recovery paths never bypass protocol transitions.
components.health_signal: Transition backlog depth and age; authoritative-state consistency probes (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact plus point-in-time recovery of authoritative state and replay of durable commands; the only authoritative-state writer, so no other rollback path exists.

components.name: Scheduler — timing-driven command emitter
components.authority_hosted: none — emits timing-driven commands into the durable command queue; owns timing only, never mutates authoritative state and never reaches external rails
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — the scheduler as a separately deployed timing process with heartbeat/missed-schedule alarms bound to observability (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (the DEP-003 scheduler + RTN-011's recurring command emitters) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; it holds no credentials and no financial authority, so it can never unlock production effects by itself.
components.health_signal: Scheduler heartbeat; missed-schedule alarms (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; schedules are configuration, so no data recovery is involved.

components.name: Reconciler workers — drift detection and corrective commands
components.authority_hosted: Reconciliation Authority semantics (registry A14) — cases, cycles, sources, and adjustments: the only exit from UNKNOWN (GC-2), with exactly-once resolution and history-never-mutated adjustments; executed as the recurring reconciliation-cycle commands through the transition path and as corrective commands through the protocol gateway — never direct state mutation, never direct rail access
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — reconciler workers as separately deployed background processes with reconciliation-lag and drift observability (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (RTN-004's A14 authority, hosted on the transition path) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; reconciliation corrections flow only as protocol commands, never as direct state mutation.
components.health_signal: Reconciliation lag; drift metrics (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; idempotent replay from the durable command path.

components.name: Netting and settlement workers — settlement and finality computation
components.authority_hosted: Netting Authority and Settlement and Finality Authority semantics (registry A11/A12) — conservation-proofed netting sets and net positions, settlement instructions/attempts over the rail adapter authority, and finality records; corrections after finality flow only through protocol-governed recourse — deployment rollback never un-finalizes
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — netting/settlement workers as separately deployed background processes with batch-progress and ledger-integrity observability (DEP-002+); real-rail settlement transmission additionally requires production rail credentials under DEP-005 (the in-process form settles over the protocol-owned simulated rails only)
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; settlement effects additionally require production rail credentials held only in the production secret scope.
components.health_signal: Settlement batch progress; ledger integrity probes (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact and replay durable commands; finality is never reversed by deployment action.

components.name: Operational jobs — reconciliation, clearing, netting and settlement-support orchestration
components.authority_hosted: none — background operational jobs and orchestration only (the DEP-004 owned surface): the durable job kinds for reconciliation sweeps (A14 cycle/case orchestration), clearing batch progression (A09 window-batch lifecycle), netting-settlement progression (A11 set progression + A12 settlement support: instruction/attempt progression only, finality NEVER — finality is the Settlement Authority's own command) and queue-draining support (A08 eligibility/expiry sweeps). The jobs derive work ONLY from the authorities' public read surfaces and emit protocol commands EXCLUSIVELY through the protocol gateway (the one admission point) with deterministic idempotency keys per (job, cycle, subject); zero authority semantics, zero direct state mutation, never serves internet traffic, never holds rail credentials, never blind-retries an UNKNOWN outcome (reconciliation is the A14 path's job)
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — the operational jobs as separately deployed background worker processes with job-lag, reconciliation-lag and batch-progression observability (DEP-002+); the in-process form (the durable operations.* job kinds on the DEP-003 substrate inside the web-api-boundary application) is the composed realization. Real-rail settlement support additionally requires production rail credentials under DEP-005 (the in-process form settles over the protocol-owned simulated rails only). The recorded D-2 vocabulary gap (INTEGRATION-EVIDENCE.md) leaves a subset of the jobs' gateway submissions queued pending the vocabulary-alignment follow-up — a composed-runtime property recorded in src/lib/operations/OPERATIONS-EVIDENCE.md, not a deployment-contract change.
components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; the jobs hold no credentials and no financial authority (commands only, through the gateway), so they can never unlock production effects by themselves; real-rail settlement transmission additionally requires the DEP-005 production rail credentials held only by the adapters.
components.health_signal: The job-progress audit reader (src/lib/operations/progress-reader.ts — the durable_events journal under the operational-jobs owner joined with the command execution observations); job lag, reconciliation lag and batch progression metrics bind to observability from DEP-002+ (the reader is the programmatic contract today).
components.rollback: Redeploy the previous artifact; the durable jobs replay from the DEP-003 queue with deterministic idempotency keys — re-execution re-derives pending work from authoritative state and re-submits the SAME keys (recorded receipts, never a second effect). Rollback never asserts or reverses finality (R3).

components.name: Durable command queue — the durable command path
components.authority_hosted: none — durable, at-least-once transport for protocol commands (the execution topology's durable command path); ordering and durability only, no financial semantics
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — the durable command queue as separately provisioned queue infrastructure with depth/age and dead-letter observability (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (the DEP-003 SQLite-backed queue inside the web-api-boundary application) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Provisioned for production only as part of the separately authorized production configuration; the queue itself transports commands and authorizes nothing.
components.health_signal: Queue depth and age; dead-letter rate (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Message retention and replay; payload semantics belong to producers and consumers, never to the queue.

components.name: Authoritative state store — protocol-owned state on deployment-owned persistence
components.authority_hosted: protocol-owned authoritative state — intent, fulfillment-policy, capability, route-plan, reservation, liquidity, credit, queue, clearing, obligation, netting, settlement-and-finality, rail-operation, and risk/compliance records (registry A01–A14 and A16; rail-operation records included per rtn-plan-rulings.md Q1) — on the per-domain persistence convention over the DEP-003 database layer; mutated only by transition-runtime through protocol-owned transitions — no other layer may mutate it directly
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — production persistence infrastructure with replication, point-in-time recovery, and backup verification (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (the per-domain SQLite stores on the DEP-003 database layer inside the web-api-boundary application) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Production persistence is provisioned only as part of the separately authorized production configuration; its contents are protocol-owned and deployment holds no financial authority over them.
components.health_signal: Replication and consistency probes; backup verification (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Point-in-time recovery plus replay of durable commands; direct external mutation is never permitted (hard boundary).

components.name: Evidence object store — append-only evidence records
components.authority_hosted: Evidence Authority records (registry A15) — append-only, hash-chained evidence over every consequential operation of every authority, plus external evidence ingested through the rail adapters; never edited or deleted within retention (GC-5)
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: externalized process binding — evidence object storage as separately provisioned infrastructure with retention-integrity observability (DEP-002+); the in-process module surface (RTN-002's A15 log + per-domain evidence store) is the composed realization
components.production_gate: Production evidence storage is provisioned only as part of the separately authorized production configuration; evidence is append-only and never rewritten by deployment action.
components.health_signal: Write and read success; retention integrity checks (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Restore from backup with append-only history preserved; rollback never rewrites evidence.

components.name: External rail adapters — banks, PSPs, mobile money, blockchains
components.authority_hosted: none — the only component that transmits to external rails; transmits exclusively protocol-authorized outputs and cannot originate or alter financial decisions; holds rail credentials and fails closed when they are absent; ingests external evidence into evidence-object-store
components.future_work: FUTURE-WORK: real-rail credential binding under DEP-005 — production rail credentials exist solely in the production secret scope, and real adapters replace the simulated rails; externalized process binding (DEP-002+) for the adapter fleet with circuit-state and rail-reachability observability. The in-process module surface is the PROTOCOL-OWNED SIMULATED RAILS: same interface, no external transmission, no real credentials, no signing capability (spec/deployment/topology.md simulation rule)
components.production_gate: Real rails are reachable only with production rail credentials that exist solely in the production secret scope; development, test-ci, sandbox and staging use protocol-owned simulated rails with no external transmission (environments.md F5/F6).
components.health_signal: Adapter circuit state; rail reachability; submission acknowledgment rate (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Fail-closed disable or hold, then replay of pending authorized submissions after recovery; financial reversals flow only through protocol-governed recourse.
